camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainHttpCodeData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2021-06-29T05:45:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2021-06-29T05:30:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the total count and proportion of HTTP status codes for accelerated domain names at a 5-minute granularity
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainHttpCodeData查询加速域名5分钟粒度的HTTP返回码总数和占比数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-http-code-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2021-06-29T05:30:00Z --end-time 2021-06-29T05:45:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names in a single query. By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time granularity of the data to query. Unit: seconds. Based on the maximum time span of a single query, this parameter supports the following values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see the supported time granularities in Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The English name of the ISP. You can call the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation to query the ISP name. If you do not specify this parameter, all ISPs are queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得。如不填该参数，则代表默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. You can call the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation to query the region name. If you do not specify this parameter, all regions are queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得。如不填该参数，则代表默认查询所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
